description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleService class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically responsible for managing job title data including retrieval, saving, deletion, and associated attachments. It interacts with Data Access Objects (DAOs) and utilizes traits for normalization.

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for managing JobTitle entities and related attachments within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Retrieves the JobTitleDao instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Fetches a list of job titles, optionally filtering by active status.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Flags specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Returns the JobTitle entity for the given ID.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Returns the JobSpecificationAttachment entity for the given ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Saves a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job titles.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns normalized job titles associated with a specific employee.
